_comment: Who USES each vaulted service account ('usages' / dependencies). Read by onboard.sh and
rotate.sh: rotation is refused while any dependency is unresolved, and for an account with NO record
(unknown is not 'none'), unless --force with a justification that names a change (CHG#######).
resolved=true means the consumer reads the password from Vault at run time (Vault Agent / API), or
was decommissioned, so a rotation cannot break it.
This file covers the Azure DC01 lab accounts. test/accounts-dependencies.e2e.json covers the Samba
test DC. Tenant time: fill it from the dependency scan in README ('Dependency discovery on DC01').
svc-backup: [] = reviewed, no consumers yet in the lab (the nightly backup job is not built).
tier0-admin-01/02: [] = reviewed (scripts/dc creates them for interactive use only). Library adds are gated too (pam-policy.json dependency_check): a human admin with no record is HELD.
